Access common and format-specific extraction metadata

```swift title="Swift"
import Xberg

let result = try await Xberg.extract("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"text/html\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/html/simple_table.html\"}", "{}")
debugPrint(result.results()[0].metadata())
debugPrint(result.results()[0].metadata().format() as Any)
```
